evals.prompt: Add a button that summarises a ticket with the AI provider.
evals.expected_output: Adds a service layer with timeout and retry, a usage log row, pricing from settings in GBP and USD, a budget check, a settings page and a mock mode.
assertions: Calls the provider through one service layer
Logs model, tokens in and out, cost, feature, user and time
Reads prices and the USD to GBP rate from settings
Shows cost in both GBP and USD
Provides a mock mode and a test for the cost calculation

evals.expected_output: Admin settings page, masked, stored encrypted, never in code or prompts or logs.
assertions: Key is masked in the UI
Stored encrypted or in a secret store

evals.expected_output: Per-user and monthly budgets in settings, a warning bar and an alert before the limit, and a test.
assertions: Limits live in settings, not code
Provides a warning before the limit (status, warning bar or alert), or names it as a follow-up slice
Adds a test for the limit
